translations.web: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
translations.bsb: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
